author: Darlek_222
body:
So My main server is Overcast or OCN but I would love to experience avicus teams and get to know players from avicus. So im Looking For Team.

My OCN stats are here if you are intrested

As for avicus you can see them on my profile - here

Pros- (I hate doing this, it sounds so cocky)
  • Good With a bow I think
  • Decent with a sword I think
  • Good at communicating with others
  • I can do stratergies, I have myy own team on ocn
  • Mature
  • Listen when I need to instead of yelling
  • Good Quality Mic
  • Experienced in tournaments
Cons-
  • Not the bext at pvp
  • Can lag sometimes
  • EU timezone

    Im not sure what you want me to write about in this thread because I have never done a LFT before but just let me know if you have any questions and I will answer them.
